text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...!
So this is Line Craft's running...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, amazing, so amazing!!
Tiara Umamusume are *this* fast?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep chasing after you, Craft!!
Do your best as a Tiara Umamusume~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —...gh, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nice...
"As a Tiara," huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Times really can change from back when 'because she was on the Tiara route' served as an excuse."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...As a Tiara Umamusume, you were trying to defeat a Triple Crown Umamusume, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's just how it ended up turning out back then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: From the start, I kept sharpening my late-stretch burst in the Tiara route just to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why on that day, I intended to hit her
with the culmination of my entire year.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And yet. After losing, I heard them say it.
"There's no way a Tiara Umamusume
can beat a Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If Hishi Amazon wasn't
a Tiara Umamusume,
she might have won," they said.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Even knowing it's just a vocal minority,
it's still frustrating and humiliating, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, that challenge of yours
also gave courage to the Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The girl who ran today is one of them as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha.
I couldn't be more grateful.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With stars widening in her eyes, Rhein Kraft prepared her next words. Whenever she got like this, it was almost always about the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"About the next race, though!
Rather than the Yasuda Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
Yes, exactly!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Umamusume on the Tiara route, the Victoria Mile is the definitive mile race. It's the spring GⅠ that decides the "Mile Queen."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right now, there are sooooo many people
paying attention to me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to carry this passion forward.
Into the races that mean so much to Tiara Umamusume.
choice_data_list: It's also so you can shine as a Tiara Umamusume.
It's also so you can shine as a Tiara Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft's eyes sparkle even brighter.
She truly loves the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? Craft-chan
said her next race is the Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Then she's definitely going to be the "Mile Queen"!
Maybe I should make a banner and go cheer for her~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I'll go call the seniors!
For the sake of that girl who's giving it her all for our sake, too...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sweet witch.
Pouting won't do your injuries any good.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. Even if it's unfortunate
that Sui-chan couldn't run in the
Victoria Mile..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Noooo!
That's not it at aalll--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Sweep.
Are you still sulking?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't we go cheer for Craft together?
I'm sure that'll cheer you right up!
Having a reliable junior around—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Dummy! Hishi Ama!!
Tummy-soothing carrots!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why can't you understand that won't work?!
Ugggghhhhh~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fine! I don't care who, just enter the Victoria Mile and go beat Craft already!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Sweep.
Just because you can't run in the Victoria Mile,
is that any reason to pout like that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Craft is a good kid.
I'm sure she'll carry on the feelings of your regrets,
and run with them—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're wrong!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Craaaash!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Sweepy, your crutches—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine. I don't need it!
I can stand on my own without any support!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I won't let her run all by herself.
—I'd never do something so boooring!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What is wrong with everyone?! So high and mighty!!
"Craft will be fine on his own."
"Craft will carry on our hopes"—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's not right, is it?! Even without her,
we made our tiaras shine from the very start!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why is everyone looking so satisfied
just because Craft showed up!?
I make, like, zerooooo sense of this!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If Craft is showing everyone
how amazing Tiara Umamusume are—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If we run alongside her at the same time,
we should be able to cast even greater magic, right!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —...Sui-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“...Come to think of it,
I wonder how long it's been since we last raced.”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We still have a chance left,
don't we?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Showing a cool and reliable back
isn't meant to be just the "juniors'" role, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the "senpais" look at each other.
Remembering the news of their junior's
decision to run in the Victoria Mile—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —As a faint warmth spread through her heart.
